sources.citation: Laycock, Donald C. 1973. Sepik languages: checklist and preliminary classification. Pacific Linguistics B-25. Canberra: ANU. Entry no. 80 'KALOU', p. 23 (PDF p. 27).
sources.note: Nothing. The Kalou entry gives only villages (Yawa, Yilui), the test wordlist DCL70 (Pagaray/Yilui) and the note 'mentioned in Laycock (1968:62), but there unnamed'. The book's general Sepik-Ramu phonology remarks (p. 20) concern vowel inventories and consonant series; a grep of the whole text layer finds no stress/accent statement for any language.
